dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello... there?

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: Aah! Traveler!? Wh—Where did you come from!?

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: Can't you see that I'm busy picturing... Um, pi—picking out clothes for Lady Ningguang?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You were drooling.

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: I... I have no idea what you're talking about! I am simply devoted to Lady Ningguang's... image. That's all!

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: Someone like her, who has all the cares of the world on her shoulders, should never have to waste an iota of her great mind on something as mundane as picking her own clothes.

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: In any case, as her secretary, it's my paramount duty to concern myself with her outward appearance!

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: ...It's just that, whenever I start thinking of Lady Ningguang's elegant form as she stands before the masses, or her silhouette as she changes her clothes... or her perfect body, glistening like polished jade as she emerges from her bath...

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: Ah, or perhaps we could go with her festive garments. Simple yet luxurious, emitting a faint fragrance as their blue folds billow...

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: I just... I just... Oh my.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I practically worship Lady Ningguang.

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: You worship her? In what way? Intellectually? Spiritually? Or...

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: Hmph! Well, whichever it is, keep it to yourself, and don't get any ideas above your station!

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang is a very busy person. She has no time for your fanaticism.

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: Let me teach you a thing or two about "diligence," and then you ought to go and reflect on your actions!

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: That gorgeous phoenix sash, woven from gold thread... Then, that figure-hugging silk dress... And last but not least, the lace lingerie... Oh my...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: Aah! Wh—Where did you come from!? ...Hmph, it's very rude to sneak up on people like that!

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: Can't you see that I'm busy picturing... Um, pi—picking out clothes for Lady Ningguang?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Carry on as you were...

dialogues.speaker: Baishi
dialogues.text: Hehe... Where was I... Ah yes, let's not forget the perfume...

dialogues.speaker: Player
